gloss: to focus (a camera/lens); to bring into focus

definitions.gloss: to focus (a camera or lens); to bring into focus
definitions.explanation: To adjust a camera lens or similar optical device so that the image is sharp and clear. Can also be used figuratively to mean focusing one's attention or discussion on a specific point.

examples.japanese: ⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ピントを{合|あ}わせる。
{被写体|ひしゃたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ピントを{合|あ}わせて⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦シャッター→シャッター：06380_shattaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}った→切る：02693_kiru⟧。
examples.english: I focused on the subject and then pressed the shutter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ピントを{合|あ}わせる⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦マニュアル→マニュアル：26993_manyuaru⟧フォーカス⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}えた→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧。
examples.english: It's hard to focus in dark places, so I switched to manual focus.

notes:
USAGE:
⟦ピント→ピント：06363_pinto⟧ comes from the Dutch word "brandpunt" (focal point). The expression uses ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧ (to adjust, to match). When the focus is off, the opposite expression is ⟦ピント→ピント：06363_pinto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ずれる→ずれる：03370_zureru⟧ (to be out of focus), which is also commonly used figuratively for missing the point in conversation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ピントを{合|あ}わせる (to focus on ~)
- ⟦ピント→ピント：06363_pinto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧ (to be in focus — intransitive)
- ⟦ピント→ピント：06363_pinto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ずれる→ずれる：03370_zureru⟧ (to be out of focus)
- ⟦ピント→ピント：06363_pinto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}わない→合う：10466_au⟧ (unable to focus; out of focus)

SIMILAR WORDS:
フォーカス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧ is a more modern synonym using the English loanword "focus." ⟦{焦点|しょうてん}→焦点：13413_shouten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{合|あ}わせる→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧ is a more formal equivalent.
